guest_static: sw_vers; uname -a; sysctl machdep.cpu hw.memsize machdep.tsc.frequency; system_profiler SPDisplaysDataType SPSerialATADataType SPUSBDataType SPPCIDataType; ioreg -p IOUSB -l; kextstat | grep -Ei "AHCI|VirtIO|SMC|XHCI"; ifconfig; ioreg -r -c AppleSMC
storage_network_display: printf hwref-macos > /Users/Shared/hwref-capture.txt; cat /Users/Shared/hwref-capture.txt; sync; rm /Users/Shared/hwref-capture.txt; ping -c 2 10.219.89.1; open -a TextEdit; sleep 3
hid_and_driver_inventory: hidutil list; ioreg -r -c AppleUSBXHCIPCI -l; ioreg -r -c AppleVirtIO -l; ioreg -r -c IONDRVFramebuffer -l

notes: Guest commands ran through vmlab exec mac --; individual HID commands are recorded in hid-exercise.json
